items.title: STAR appears in Findings of EMNLP 2026
items.previewTitle: Our work on inference-time backdoors in LLM reasoning appears in Findings of EMNLP 2026.
body: Our paper, STAR: Detecting Inference-Time Backdoors in LLM Reasoning via Prior-Posterior Amplification, appears in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026.
The work studies inference-time backdoors in language-model reasoning and proposes a lightweight detector based on prior-posterior amplification.

items.title: Soongsil University features RoCo, our proactive defense against voice cloning
items.previewTitle: Soongsil University featured our proactive voice-cloning defense, RoCo, accepted to ICASSP 2026.
body: Soongsil University's AI Safety Center published a press release on RoCo, a proactive protection method designed to make unauthorized voice cloning more difficult. The paper was presented at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing.

items.title: Joined the AI Safety Center at Soongsil University
items.previewTitle: Joined the AI Safety Center at Soongsil University as a Research Professor.
body: I joined the AI Safety Center at Soongsil University as a Research Professor. My work focuses on AI security and safety, robust computer vision, adversarial machine learning, and generative-AI defense.
